summary: Sandbach United claimed a dramatic late victory over Brereton Social, with Robbie Hatton volleying in a stoppage-time winner from a corner to secure a 1-0 win. It was a tight, low-key affair for most of the match, though the team showed character to snatch victory in the closing stages. The result comes as Nelson moved to the top of the Premier Division following their 5-2 win over Abbey Hey.
